WHAT: EmojiKeyboardView redesigned to match native iOS 26 emoji keyboard exactly
WHERE: whisnap-ios/Whisnap-IOS/WhisnapKeyboard/EmojiKeyboardView.swift
HOW:
- columnCount = 7 (native is 7, not 8)
- UISearchBar at top with delegate for keyword filtering
- filteredCategories computed: when search active, flattens all emoji into single section matching query; else uses displayCategories
- Frequently Used category at index 0 (static list of ~30 most common emoji)
- Section headers per category (e.g. 'FREQUENTLY USED', 'SMILEYS & PEOPLE')
- Lithuanian flag 🇱🇹 added to flags category and flags emoji array
- Search bar colors wired into applyColors() for dark/light mode
WHY: Match native iOS 26 emoji keyboard pixel-for-pixel
GOTCHA: No recently-used tracking (would require UserDefaults persistence), no skin tones, no stickers — these are documented gaps
